closed_decisions.summary: Staleness CHECK now covers both the activation snapshot and the ongoing didReceiveApplicationContext path. The RESPONSE splits: resetToIdle() when cached (activation) or when the payload explicitly says state 'idle'; otherwise drop the stale payload and keep current state. Out-of-order lastAppliedAt check moved above the staleness check.
closed_decisions.why: The 17 Aug diff routed every stale payload into resetToIdle(), which calls WorkoutSession.shared.end(). On the ongoing path that is reachable mid-walk, and age there is ambiguous - a backgrounded phone whose JS push effect is throttled looks identical to a delayed delivery. A false positive would drop the watch out of a live walk and make the app more suspendable.
closed_decisions.correction: Prior wording 'stale-snapshot guard removal' was wrong in the ledger, the buglist and this file. The change broadens the guard; what the 17 Aug diff removed was the 'cached' parameter.
